independent_conclusion: No demonstrated departure from the four recorded domain acceptance assertions in the supplied snapshot. This does not establish full feature completion.
basis: Assess calls the task, evidence, explanation and coverage assertion methods before returning.
Evidence grounding rejects missing passage keys, blank quotes and nonmatching supplied text.
The semantic evaluator owns judgment of whether a quoted passage actually demonstrates a departure; nonempty departure/correction checks do not purport to decide that meaning.
Application orchestration invokes the domain operation, preserves caller evidence across the provider call, and returns provider/domain failures as unavailable.
Coverage preservation merges evidence and candidate limits, then checks that neither set was omitted.
limits_assessment: The output preserves all four supplied limits and does not infer chronology, native activation or successful tests. One limit entry is actually a supported positive ownership observation; that is presentation imprecision, not an invented violation.
not_proven: Full evidence collector correctness (collector source intentionally not supplied).
Native host invocation/trust or resumed-session behavior.
Repository gate execution or correctness of domain meanings beyond the supplied assessment contract.
provenance: Public /tmp/arclint-workflow agents workflow review invocation, production Codex evaluator, actual current ArcLint domain/decision/source/diff evidence; no deterministic model fixture.
